author: cms-sw
body:
Update GCC to newer version 14.4.1. Also minimum supported micro architecture for CMSSW 20.1.X is `x86-64-v2` so enable GCC to have `x86-64-v2` as default so that full software stack is build with `x86-64-v2` unless overrdden by multi-micro architecture flag.

Note that on `EL9` system GCC also use `x86-64-v2`  default. So this change will match `EL9` system GCC. But this will also build `el8` stack with `x86-64-v2`. This should be fine as CMSSW 20.1.X already support  `x86-64-v2`  and above miro architectures.
title: GCC 14.4.1 with default full stack build with x86-64-v2
